Players Committee card image of [[Vaneé]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -3 to a site with 'Vader' in game text. Once during your turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per game, may take a card with 'Vader' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
